= CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRestore Resource
include::partial$autogen-reference-aliases.adoc[tags=couchbasesnapshotbackuprestore]
:resource-name-singular: couchbasesnapshotbackuprestore
:resource-name-plural: couchbasesnapshotbackuprestores
:resource-name-kind: CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRestore

CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRestore represents a single CSI VolumeSnapshot based restore request
and its progress.
It names a source CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRun and a target
CouchbaseCluster.
The target must already exist as a CR before a restore can act on it,
if it is running, the restore replaces its data (a destructive rollback).
If it is
hibernated with no pods, the restore fills its volumes and starts it up.
If no
CouchbaseCluster with that name exists at all, the request is rejected until one is
created.

== couchbasesnapshotbackuprestores.spec

=== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `object`

=== Description

CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRestoreSpec names what to restore, and where to.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackuprestores.spec.backupName

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

BackupName is the CouchbaseBackup that scheduled the run to restore from.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackuprestores.spec.runName

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

RunName is the specific CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRun to restore.
This field is
required and must always be set explicitly.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackuprestores.spec.target

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `object`

==== Description

Target describes the cluster to restore into.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackuprestores.spec.target.acknowledgeBucketGap

==== Constraints

*Type*: `boolean`

==== Description

AcknowledgeBucketGap must be true when the run's recorded buckets, scopes, or
collections are not all covered by CRs that will exist at restore time.
Without
this acknowledgement, ordinary bucket reconciliation would delete that data again
immediately after the restore completes.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackuprestores.spec.target.acknowledgeDataLoss

==== Constraints

*Type*: `boolean`

==== Description

AcknowledgeDataLoss must be true when the target already exists and is running.
Restoring into a running cluster deletes its current pods and volumes first, this
is irreversible.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackuprestores.spec.target.name

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

Name is the target CouchbaseCluster's name.
If no CouchbaseCluster with this name
exists yet, the request is rejected, create the target first, hibernated and with
zero pods, before restoring into it.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackuprestores.spec.target.serverSecretName

==== Constraints

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

ServerSecretName is the TLS certificate secret for the target cluster.
Required
only when the target is a new, differently named cluster, since the restored data
won't already have a certificate valid for it.
